messages:
deploy-bot: Starting PROD deploy (us-west-2) of release tag v2.8.1 :rocket:

deploy-bot: Triggered by CI pipeline. Commits/PRs included: 
```
8ad4f2c - Improve KV cache eviction (hugo) - https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/commit/8ad4f2c
2b7c9a1 - Kernel selector tweak (sara) - https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/commit/2b7c9a1
f1e3d9b - Fix autoscaler race condition (neha) - https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/commit/f1e3d9b
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/914 (author: hugo)
```

sara: tagging release notes and pinning a fallback tag v2.8.0-pin in case we need to rollback. change-window until 11:45 UTC. @hugo can you confirm we included the monitoring hooks? :eyes:

hugo: confirmed — canary smoke passed (latency +1ms). monitoring hooks + dashboards updated.

neha: oncall watching logs and error budgets, will escalate if 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m.

ci-bot: Deploy progress: nodes updated 14/42 -> 28/42 -> 42/42. All post-deploy health checks returned ok. Runtime image: registry.redwood/cloud-runtime:2026-03-20-8ad4f2c

deploy-bot: Post-deploy quick checks: latency p95 +3ms, tail mem stable, errors delta +0.02% — within SLOs. If rollback required reply with "rollback v2.8.0-pin". :white_check_mark:

[six minutes later]
sara: I'm seeing a spike of tokenization errors in the logs from prod instance 172.31.12.4, rate ~0.9% but concentrated on a user query pattern. tagging @hugo

hugo: looking, reproducing locally with the failing input. suspect change in kernel selector affecting tokenization fallback. Initiating rollback to pinned tag v2.8.0-pin.

sara: approved. change-window still open.
hugo: command: `redwoodctl rollout pin --env prod --tag v2.8.0-pin --reason "tokenization spike"`

deploy-bot: Rollback started to v2.8.0-pin. Target nodes: 42. ETA ~7m. Commits rolled back: 8ad4f2c, 2b7c9a1, f1e3d9b.

ci-bot: Rollback progress: nodes rolled back 10/42 -> 30/42 -> 42/42. Health checks passing.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Prod running tag v2.8.0-pin. Post-rollback checks: latency p95 baseline, tokenization errors returned to 0.03%.

neha: marking incident ticket INC-2026-0423 and notifying customers on the status page.
sara: adding a follow-up todo to root cause: kernel selector + tokenization interaction. Will open a revert PR and a smaller patch PR after investigation. Thanks everyone. :v:
